generated.details: The cream ceramic coffee cup has a rounded bowl, joined loop handle and visible coffee inside.
The small cream pastry plate has a shallow well and raised circular rim.
One croissant rests in the well, its tapered curved ends connected by a flaky, layered golden body.
The teaspoon has a slender metal handle flowing into a shallow oval bowl.
Its padded seat and upright back share a wooden plinth.
On the far upper-left wall, the chalkboard menu is a dark inset panel enclosed by a wooden frame, with indistinct chalk smudges instead of letters.
